item.title: Flock wanted to tap dashcams in rideshare vechicles to add to surveillance data
item.description:
📝 Flock wanted to tap dashcams in rideshare vechicles to add to surveillance data August 10, 2026 Topic Data Sharing / 404 Media, Flock, privacy, rideshare To augment its network of license plate readers, surveillance company Flock drew up plans to partner with dashcam company Nexar and use Uber and Lyft drivers to passively collect data. But the presentation still shows Flock’s ambitious plan to conscript rideshare and delivery drivers to collect license plate data for its network. Related Ring cancels partnership with law enforcement supplier Flock Uber and Lyft use lockout loophole to avoid paying drivers Lowe’s and Home Depot are sharing customer data with law enforcement.
🔗 Read more: https://flowingdata.com/2026/08/10/flock-wanted-to-tap-dashcams-in-rideshare-vechicles-to-add-to-surveillance-data/
